title: Norm bound for the Boolean block expectation
statement: For natural numbers $n,m$, a real number $\rho$ with $0\le\rho\le1$, and a continuous complex-valued function $F$ on the torus indexed by $(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})\sqcup(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})$, the norm of its Boolean block expectation, formed using blocks of size $m$ and correlation parameter $\rho$, is at most the supremum norm of $F$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a continuous complex-valued function on the specified torus
